Also \(4n^2-1=(2n-1)(2n+1)\), so \(4n^2\equiv1\pmod{2n+1}\). Hence \(4(100+n^2)\equiv400+1=401\pmod{2n+1}\), giving \(d_n=\gcd(401,2n+1)\). The number 401 is prime (no prime up to \(\sqrt{401}<21\) divides it), so the only possible gcd values are 1 and 401. The value 401 occurs if \(401\mid 2n+1\); taking \(n=200\) gives \(2n+1=401\), so \(d_{200}=401\). Thus the maximum is \(\boxed{401}\).
